title: VERB: Visualizing and Interpreting Bias Mitigation Techniques for Word Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to compare male/female word associations with career/family words, the Embedding Coherence Test (ECT) for stereotypical occupation associations, NLI-based entailment tests with counterfactual gender substitutions, and interactive visual subspace projections.

Evaluated interactively by defining a concept subspace for royalty (e.g., 'king/queen' vs. 'man/woman') and visualizing the projection of descriptive adjectives (e.g., 'majestic' vs. 'obnoxious') onto this axis.
Visualized through subspace clustering of merchant embeddings to demonstrate how geographical location inadvertently dominates recommendation embeddings over relevant features like cuisine type.
